tools.name: list_verdicts
tools.description: Which LLM is the cheapest that still passes? Lists every published Clearbar verdict: the task, the pass bar, the cheapest passing model, its cost per successful task (retries and failures counted) and the page to check it. Optional filter by task type.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: The full verdict for one task: the cheapest model that clears the bar, its pass rate and cost per successful task in US dollars, the baseline model it is compared with, every candidate's status, plus links to the verdict page, the run file (JSON) and the script that re-runs it. Get the slug from lis
